items.distractor_fact: Termometer pribadi milik seorang warga di kota lain menunjukkan angka {D} pada sore itu.
items.gloss_en: A resident of a different city's personal thermometer showed the number {D} that afternoon.
items.entity_note: a resident of a different city and their own personal thermometer (a person), differing in kind from the first sentence's neighboring-village weather station (a place).

items.distractor_fact: Nilai portofolio saham milik seorang investor pribadi ditutup pada {D} pada hari yang sama.
items.gloss_en: An individual investor's private stock portfolio value closed at {D} on the same day.
items.entity_note: a private individual investor and their own portfolio (a person), differing in kind from the first sentence's other listed company (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: Reservoir milik perusahaan air minum setempat tercatat berada di ketinggian {D} pada musim yang sama.
items.gloss_en: A reservoir owned by the local drinking-water utility company was recorded at a height of {D} in the same season.
items.entity_note: a water utility company and its own reservoir (an organisation), differing in kind from the first sentence's lake in a neighboring district (a place).

items.distractor_fact: Pesawat model milik seorang penghobi lain tercatat terbang pada ketinggian {D} pada hari yang sama.
items.gloss_en: A different hobbyist's model aircraft was recorded flying at an altitude of {D} on the same day.
items.entity_note: a hobbyist and their own named model aircraft (a person), differing in kind from the first sentence's different drone with no owner stated (an instrument).

items.distractor_fact: Tim atletik dari sekolah lain mencatat rata-rata berat badan pemainnya sebesar {D} pada pemeriksaan serupa musim itu.
items.gloss_en: An athletics team from a different school recorded an average player weight of {D} at a similar check that season.
items.entity_note: a different school's athletic team and its own aggregate figure (an organisation), differing in kind from the first sentence's different athlete on the same team (a person).

items.distractor_fact: Pada seri balapan musim lalu, kecepatan tertinggi yang tercatat di papan skor adalah {D}.
items.gloss_en: In last season's racing series, the top speed recorded on the scoreboard was {D}.
items.entity_note: last season's racing series and its own scoreboard record (a different series/edition), differing in kind from the first sentence's different race car on the same track (an instrument).

items.distractor_fact: Koperasi sekolah memiliki total dana kas sebesar {D} pada minggu itu.
items.gloss_en: The school cooperative had a total cash fund of {D} that week.
items.entity_note: the school cooperative's own cash fund (an organisation), differing in kind from the first sentence's sibling (a person).

items.distractor_fact: Cabang bank lain di kota yang sama mencatat total setoran seluruh nasabahnya sebesar {D} bulan itu.
items.gloss_en: A different bank branch in the same city recorded total deposits from all its customers as {D} that month.
items.entity_note: a different bank branch and its own aggregate total (an organisation), differing in kind from the first sentence's different individual customer (a person).

items.distractor_fact: Seorang pedagang keliling di sekitar pasar itu memperoleh penghasilan sebesar {D} pada bulan yang sama.
items.gloss_en: A traveling vendor near that market earned an income of {D} in the same month.
items.entity_note: an individual traveling vendor (a person), differing in kind from the first sentence's different small business at the same market (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: Pencetak gol terbanyak di liga itu pada musim sebelumnya mencetak {D} gol secara individu.
items.gloss_en: The league's top individual goal-scorer from the previous season scored {D} goals individually.
items.entity_note: an individual player's personal tally from a previous season (a person, and a different series/edition), differing in kind from the first sentence's different team in the same league (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: Turnamen amal yang diselenggarakan panitia berbeda mencatat salah satu pesertanya menyelesaikan permainan dengan {D} pukulan, pada lapangan yang parnya tidak diumumkan.
items.gloss_en: A charity tournament organized by a different committee recorded one of its participants finishing with {D} strokes, on a course whose par was not announced.
items.entity_note: a different tournament committee and an unnamed participant on a course with no stated par (an organisation), differing in kind from the first sentence's individual golfer on a different course (a person); satisfies the shared-reference rule since that course's par is never given.

items.distractor_fact: Bus milik perusahaan otobus lain tiba di terminalnya sendiri pada menit {D} dari titik acuan waktu itu, tanpa jadwal resmi yang disebutkan untuknya.
items.gloss_en: A bus belonging to a different bus company arrived at its own terminal at minute {D} from that time reference point, with no official schedule stated for it.
items.entity_note: a different bus company and its own vehicle/terminal (an organisation), differing in kind from the first sentence's different train on a different line (an instrument); satisfies the shared-reference rule since no schedule is stated for this bus.

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah gedung apartemen yang dikelola oleh perusahaan pengelola properti lain memiliki unit di lantai {D}, tanpa lantai lobi acuan yang disebutkan untuk gedung itu.
items.gloss_en: An apartment building managed by a different property management company has a unit on floor {D}, with no reference lobby floor stated for that building.
items.entity_note: a different property management company and its own building (an organisation), differing in kind from the first sentence's different hotel building (a place); satisfies the shared-reference rule since no lobby reference floor is stated for it.
